records.subject: You're in -- let's get Lantern Media set up
records.body:
Hi Jules,

Welcome! A lot of new teams ask us the same thing in the first few days: how do I get my team in here. Short answer -- a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time.

Reply any time.

Cheers,
Priya Chen

decisions.rationale: Project created day 0 (2026-06-12) but nothing since; no invites sent, no tickets, and zero replies to two outreach emails (email:37c2e59a, email:5fc0d18b). Engagement appears to have stopped after initial setup, so unaided milestone in the remaining 8 days is unlikely though not impossible on an active Pro plan.

draft.subject: One next step for Lantern Media
draft.body:
Hi Jules,

Since you've got a project up and running in Wrenfield, the usual next step is bringing the rest of the team in — a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time, and teammates can be bulk-invited from a CSV file instead of one at a time if that's easier.

Would a short call this week help? I'm happy to walk through how your projects are organized and what makes sense to set up next for Lantern Media.

Best,
Priya
